Name: VSDinside MagTran M3
Description: Device support for the VSDinside MagTran M3 (5548:1020): keys, dials, and the display behind the keys
Author: Grant Garrison

Actions.Name: Background preset
Actions.Tooltip: Switches the animated background to another preset. On a key, each press moves to the next. On a dial, turn right to go forward and left to go back; pressing the dial moves to the next.
